title: Grays' moon base

tellings.quote: The grays who have a base on the moon come and go at any time they want.

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the Nevada desert at a military base among tall, pale beings he calls the tall whites, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about another group, the grays, the small grey-skinned beings common in these accounts. He says the grays have a base on the Moon and come and go whenever they want.
